title: Redact Secret qualification view v1
description: Deterministic output of the RunArtifact to qualification adapter (#605, docs/specs/qualification-adapter.md). One view cites one artifact per population; counts stay per population and are never pooled. Status is computed here by the benchmark-owned rules; credential-eval never emits one.

publication.description: public only when every contributing artifact is publication public and its population is publishable.

revision.description: The product policy revision stamp: SHA-256 over the adapter identity and one digest per benchmark-owned qualification input.

axisOverlay.description: The product-owned axis overlay the floors were counted with (benchmarks/support/public-axis-overlay.json); its digest is a policy component.

differentialPeers.description: The peer scanners whose differential occurrences the gate reads (population-policy.json methods.differential.peers). Other peers are measured and reported (families[].differential), never gate-bearing.

attributionFallback.description: How a case the snapshot attributes to no product detector is attributed, in order (population-policy.json attribution.fallback).

ledgerRekey.description: The legacy review-ledger decisions mapped to canonical occurrence ids (benchmarks/support/public-review-ledger-map.json); its digest is a policy component.

axisCoverage.description: The populations whose axis labels are unioned into a family axis floor (benchmarks/support/population-policy.json axisCoverage). Counts are never summed.

twinScope.description: The twin-scope map: public twins the snapshot gives no family, gated through the project case that carries them with their parent family (benchmarks/support/public-twin-scope-map.json); its digest is a policy component.

denominator.description: Equal to the population id: one denominator per population.

methodsArtifact.description: The methods run of the floors population: a second official artifact over the same evidence whose cases are generated variants. Absent when no methods run was made.

unattributed.description: Counts of cases that map to no product detector family, per scanner.

aggregates.description: The engine's published aggregates, verbatim (withheld figures stay withheld); never recomputed here.

cases.description: Every case of the population with each scanner's own measurement, sorted by id (#606). Additive within v1: no count or status above is derived from it; it feeds the Next case pages only.

unmeasured.description: Cases (and methods variants) a complete scanner could not map to ranges (RunArtifact v1.2 unmeasured_cases). They are in no denominator and are never zero detections or misses.

scope.description: Scope accounting per scanner of the plain artifact (#724), sorted by scanner id. Additive within v1.

methodsScope.description: The same for the methods artifact, kept apart from the plain one.

profileEffects.description: Declared credential profiles against their default scanner, plain artifact only.

origins.description: Where each scanner's observation of the plain artifact came from (#724): provenance read from the artifact's non-semantic telemetry, sorted by scanner id. `not-recorded` is what an artifact says when the run did not offer observations for reuse; it is never read as fresh. Feeds no count, outcome, denominator or status. Additive within v1.

methodsOrigins.description: The same for the methods artifact, kept apart from the plain one.

evidence.description: FamilySupportEvidence (benchmarks/support/status.ts) as derived from the artifacts.

gates.description: The zero-tolerance gate inputs of each gate-bearing population, side by side. Never summed.

twinPairsScopedElsewhere.description: Twin pairs of this population the twin-scope map takes out of its gate because a project population measures them with the parent family.

twinFailuresScopedElsewhere.description: Of those, the pairs the engine read as not discriminating in this population. Reported, not gate-bearing.

differential.description: The differential review occurrences of the methods run attributed to the family, per peer. Only gate-bearing peers count toward the stable gate; null when the methods run did not run differential.

unmeasuredVariants.description: Generated variants this peer could not measure in the methods run: no relation or comparison exists for them, so they are not occurrences and not agreement.

attribution.description: How the floors population cases of the family were attributed to it: by what the snapshot names, by the overlay legacy targets, or through the twin parent.

axisCoverage.description: The axes the family floors were judged on, each with the populations that supplied it. Coverage is the union of labels across the policy axisCoverage populations; counts are never summed.

supportMatrix.description: The support matrix (#607): one entry per taxonomy family (provider x credential family), each carrying the status and evidence of the detector family that decided it, derived from `families[]` and the product taxonomy. The same projection as the legacy eval:matrix output. A taxonomy family with no detector is unsupported or pending with its recorded reason.

undetected.description: Taxonomy families with no detector: representable, undetected.

matches.description: Cases with this id, per population; empty when the id does not exist in a population (a re-key, #607).

unmappedFamilies.description: population:family pairs the artifact names that no product detector family serves.

scannerRoster.description: The evaluation contract's scanner roster as applied to this view (#763, benchmarks/support/scanner-roster.json): the required and optional scanners of the official run class, the scanners this view measured, and every optional scanner it did NOT measure, with the reason and the pointer to its last recorded measurement. A scanner not measured is stated here; it is never a zero.

archive.description: For a retained measurement (the registry no longer lists its runs): the immutable archive release that holds the artifacts.

profiles.description: Every optional scanner of the roster, measured or not (#764): its label, the profile it is, what it detects, the scanner it is a profile of and its configuration identity. A profile is labelled separately from the default and never spliced with it; both are the same package under different configurations, so results differ by configuration and no accuracy claim follows.

caseResult.description: One scanner's measurement of one case as the RunArtifact recorded it. A field that does not apply to the measurement is absent. A pending case and a case that was not measured are their own words, never a miss and never a pass.

outcomes.description: A positive case: one outcome per expected span. Absent for other measurements.

flagged.description: A control only: whether the scanner flagged it.

observed.description: Findings the scanner reported on the case.

status.description: A case that was not measured: the scanner status that prevented the measurement, as the artifact names it.

caseRow.description: One corpus case of a population (#606), keyed by (population, id). Evidence class is the artifact's own label and never a support status; detectors and attribution are the adapter's product attribution. No case content is carried.

path.description: The case's path inside the population's corpus.

family.description: The family the corpus names (a taxonomy family or a detector id), not the product family.

detectors.description: The product detector families the case counts under; empty for an unattributed case.

envelope.description: The span of the surrounding assignment or block, when the corpus records one.

results.description: One entry per scanner that ran the population.

scopeEntry.description: One scanner's scope accounting for one artifact (#724): what the ENGINE's reviewed disposition table (credential-eval ADR 0016) says about the findings the artifact retains. Never recomputed here; an accounting that does not reconcile to the retained findings is refused at build time. Null counts mean not accounted (legacy engine, no reviewed table, not measured), never zero.

profileEffect.description: Before/after of a declared credential profile against the default result of the same scanner on the same population (delta = profile - default). Separate observations with their own identities; nothing is spliced, excluded or re-scored.
